payout_quote: NYC Board of Elections: Election Day pay $250 for inspectors, poll clerks, and information clerks (plus $100 training pay after passing the exam); interpreters and accessibility clerks $250 plus $25 training pay. Election Day begins at 5:00 a.m. and ends after polls close and dismissal.
steps: Complete required training and pass the exam
Work Election Day from 5:00 a.m. until after polls close and you are dismissed
Receive $250 for Election Day plus training pay ($100 inspectors/clerks, $25 interpreters)
catches: Very long day: 5:00 a.m. start until after 9 p.m. close plus teardown — ~16+ hours.
Training pay only after passing the exam; fail it and you lose the training pay.
Work is per-election, not steady — a few days per year.
biggest_catch: A ~16-hour day starting at 5 a.m.; the $250 works out to roughly $15/hour before training pay.
eligibility: US citizens 18+ registered to vote in NYC (17-year-old students may serve with restrictions per BOE).
timing: Paid after Election Day service and qualifying training.
